verses.english: This was said by the Buddha, the Perfected One: that is what I heard.

verses.pali: “Dvīhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhaṁ viharati savighātaṁ saupāyāsaṁ sapariḷāhaṁ;
verses.english: “Mendicants, when a mendicant has two qualities they live unhappily in this very life—with distress, anguish, and fever—

verses.pali: kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā duggati pāṭikaṅkhā.
verses.english: and when the body breaks up, after death, they can expect a bad rebirth.

verses.pali: Indriyesu aguttadvāratāya ca, bhojane amattaññutāya ca.
verses.english: Not guarding the sense doors and eating too much.

verses.pali: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, dvīhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhaṁ viharati savighātaṁ saupāyāsaṁ sapariḷāhaṁ;
verses.english: When a mendicant possesses these two qualities they live unhappily in this very life—with distress, anguish, and fever—

verses.pali: kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā duggati pāṭikaṅkhā”ti.
verses.english: and when the body breaks up, after death, they can expect a bad rebirth.”
such a person lives in suffering.”

verses.pali: Ayampi attho vutto bhagavatā, iti me sutanti.
verses.english: This too is a matter that was spoken by the Blessed One: that is what I heard.
